faqs.a: Monday to Saturday. Adyar and T. Nagar: 10:00–13:00 and 16:00–20:00. Anna Nagar: 10:00–18:00. Sundays are closed.
Come 10 minutes early. Bring any old dental reports or X-rays, and a list of medicines you take. You can book the checkup on this chat.
The branch confirms the fee when you arrive. A checkup and a cleaning are priced separately. Ask the desk if you already have a treatment in mind.

For toothache, book a Tooth pain visit and take the earliest slot. If there is heavy bleeding, facial swelling, or a knock to the teeth, call the branch or go to urgent care. Don't wait on a chat slot for that.
Children are welcome. Book a Dental checkup and tell the dentist the child's age when you arrive.
Book a Braces consult at any branch. The dentist will say whether braces or aligners fit after looking in the chair.
Book a Whitening consult. The dentist checks your teeth first and explains what whitening can and cannot do.
If you can't make a visit, message this chat and book a new slot. Give the branch a few hours' notice when you can, so the chair can go to someone else. Tell them the old booking ref.
Root canal treatment is decided after the dentist examines you. Book a Tooth pain visit or a Dental checkup, and bring any earlier X-ray.
Implant treatment starts with an exam and an X-ray. Book a Dental checkup and the dentist will tell you if an implant is suitable.
